data.name: Maymoonah
data.gender_notes: Maymoonah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'muna', meaning 'to desire' or 'to wish for'. A name for a girl who is a source of blessings. The name Maymoonah carries the meaning “Blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maymoonah usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Maymoonah (رضي الله عنها) was one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ). She was known for her generosity, kindness, and hospitality.
data.etymology: Maymoonah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maymoonah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ميمونة
in_arabic.meaning: مباركة، سعيدة، محظوظة، ناجحة في الحياة
in_arabic.long_meaning: ميمونة اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'ميمون' التي تعني السعادة والبركة. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالخير والنجاح. ورد اسم ميمونة في التاريخ الإسلامي، حيث كانت ميمونة بنت الحارس زوجة للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

in_urdu.name: میمونہ
in_urdu.meaning: خوش قسمت، مبارک، سعید، زندگی میں کامیاب
in_urdu.long_meaning: میمونہ ایک عربی मूल کا اسم علم مؤنث ہے، جو 'میمون' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سعادت اور برکت۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں پسندیدہ ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، کیونکہ یہ اچھائی اور کامیابی سے وابستہ ہے۔ ميمونة بنت الحارس رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم کی زوجہ تھیں۔

in_hindi.name: मैमूना
in_hindi.meaning: सुखी, मंगलमय, भाग्यशाली, जीवन में सफल
in_hindi.long_meaning: मैमूना एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो 'मैमून' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है सुख और आशीर्वाद। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में पसंदीदा नामों में से एक है, क्योंकि यह अच्छाई और सफलता से जुड़ा हुआ है। मिमूना बिनत अल-हरिस, पैगंबर मुहम्मद की पत्नी थीं।

in_pashto.name: میمونه
in_pashto.meaning: بریا، نیک، خوشحال، په ژوند کې بریالی
in_pashto.long_meaning: میمونه د عربي اصل يو ښځينه نوم دی، چې د 'میمون' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې خوښۍ او برکت دي. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په منځ کې یو له خوښې وړ نومونو څخه دی، ځکه چې دا د نیکۍ او بریالیتوب سره تړاو لري. ميمونة بنت الحارس د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم ښځه وه.

in_english.name: Maymoonah
in_english.meaning: Blessed, happy, fortunate, successful in life
in_english.long_meaning: Maymoonah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from 'maymun', which means blessed, happy, or fortunate. It is a popular name in Islamic culture, symbolizing goodness and success. Maymoonah bint al-Haris was a wife of the Prophet Muhammad, adding to its historical and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل میمونه

In various Islamic communities, girls with the name Maymoonah are often treated with great affection and respect, as they are seen as a source of positive energy, encouragement, and emotional support for their families and communities. Moreover, this name may also resonate with those who value perseverance and a strong dedication towards their goals, as 'muna' also means 'to struggle' in Arabic.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Maymoonah is deeply rooted within the teachings of Islam. This name is associated with the concept of hope, desire, and a wish for spiritual and personal growth. It also signifies the importance of striving towards one's goals with determination and endurance, as reflected in the meaning of 'muna' as 'to struggle'. Furthermore, Maymoonah is a name that invites peace, love, and blessings, reflecting the spiritual values of compassion, kindness, and self-improvement ingrained within Islamic teachings. Ultimately, Maymoonah is a name evoking both the human aspiration for growth and the divine blessings that guide and nurture us along our spiritual journey.
